description: This file contains utility functions related to prompt processing, including extracting template variables, obtaining prompt IDs and versions, extracting models, and retrieving provider information. It is part of the prompt editing or handling functionality in a UI component of a larger project.

methods.name: extractTemplateVariables
methods.description: Extracts template variables enclosed in {{}} from prompt content, assigning example values.

methods.name: getBasePromptId
methods.description: Returns the base prompt ID from the PromptSpec, stripping version information.

methods.name: getVersionedPromptId
methods.description: Returns the versioned prompt ID, preserving version info from PromptSpec or its parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of the prompt, either from explicit version field or by extracting from prompt ID.

methods.name: extractModel
methods.description: Extracts the model name from prompt metadata, trying multiple possible locations.

methods.name: getProviderFromModelHub
methods.description: Retrieves the provider name for a given model from model hub data.
